purpose: Screen additional public fueling and tank experiments for an independent holdout without promoting incomplete records.

candidates.reason: Public record describes the reference campaign but exposes no reusable machine-readable trace or reuse terms.
The article provides boundary conditions and figures, but the underlying logger data are not publicly released.
The local workbook is independently screened as a tank candidate, but station-side channels and redistribution rights are absent.
Aggregate products do not provide synchronized event-level station-to-vehicle traces.
NIST reports seven field drafts and synchronized measurement methods, but the public technical report does not expose the machine-readable logger files needed for a frozen holdout.

scope_effect: Keep full-loop external validation outside the primary claim and retain the component-level validation plan.
next_action: Request a rights-cleared, de-identified logger export from a listed custodian and freeze the protocol before inspecting outcomes.
claim_boundary: A public paper or aggregate dashboard is not treated as raw time-series validation evidence.
